title: Xi Touts Party-Led Growth at Predecessor’s Birth Centenary
summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping upheld former leader Jiang Zemin’s legacy of combining economic development with firm Communist Party rule, using the centenary of his predecessor’s birth to reinforce the political foundations of his own agenda.

title: Hong Kong Court Orders Unit of SDIC Commodities to Liquidate
summary: A unit of China’s state-backed SDIC Commodities Co. was ordered to liquidate by a Hong Kong court, adding to the financial troubles for the metals trader as Beijing increases scrutiny on the sector.

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for June 17
summary: Oil rose as fresh fighting in Lebanon and attacks on vessels in the Strait of Hormuz muddied the outlook for a deal to end the US-Iran war.

title: ‘Too Big to Ban’ WuXi AppTec Gains 100% on GLP-1 Chokehold
summary: The Pentagon’s designation of WuXi AppTec Co. as a Chinese military company may have prompted some US clients to pull back, but investors are still piling into the stock betting the firm will remain central to the global supply of obesity, cancer and other drugs.

title: Trump Says He’s Curtailing Drills With South Korea
summary: President Donald Trump said he told the Pentagon to “substantially reduce” joint military exercises with South Korea, citing the cost of the drills and the signal they send to North Korea. Bloomberg’s Jon Herskovitz breaks down the situation. (Corrects spelling mistake in reporter’s name.) (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Silver Traders Brave Red Tape to Capture Indian Premiums
summary: Shipments of silver into India are picking up despite administrative hurdles, as traders seek to capitalize on attractive premiums after a new licensing regime disrupted imports.

title: Copper Heads Toward Record High on LME as Supply Tensions Build
summary: Copper extended a seven-week rally to head toward a record, with a key price spread on the London Metal Exchange widening to unusual levels in a clear sign of rising competition for short-term supply.

title: Dollar Dips as Fed Hike Bets Ease, Treasuries Gain: Markets Wrap
summary: The dollar weakened against most of its major peers after soft US economic data reduced bets on a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike next month. Treasuries rose.

title: Sri Lankan Inflation to Slow Toward Goal, Central Bank Head Says
summary: Sri Lanka’s inflation is expected to slow back toward the central bank’s target of 5% over the second half of this year and into next year, according to Governor Nandalal Weerasinghe.

title: NAB Shares Drop as Mortgage Growth in Australia Seen Slowing
summary: National Australia Bank Ltd. shares fell Monday after the lender revealed slowing mortgage growth and cash earnings that were below consensus estimates.

title: A2 Milk Sees Slow Recovery From China Formula Supply Problem
summary: New Zealand infant formula supplier a2 Milk expects only a gradual recovery from supply chain disruptions that impacted its China sales earlier this year, signaling the earnings margins will be soft in the six months through December.

title: Thai Baht Rally May Fade on Dovish Central Bank, Analysts Say
summary: A nascent rally in the Thai baht may be short-lived as the central bank is likely to maintain a dovish policy stance to support an economy hit by elevated oil prices, according to analysts.

title: Gold Steady Near $4,400 as Traders Weigh US Data and Rate Path
summary: Gold was steady as traders weighed the competing impacts of cooling US economic data and energy-led inflation pressure on the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate path.

title: Bonds Face a Bigger Threat Than the Fed as Global Rates Climb
summary: As investors debate whether and when the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates, market expectations for further tightening are building around the world — and spelling trouble for bonds.

title: Trump Says Asked Pentagon to Cut Military Drills With S. Korea
summary: “I have instructed Secretary of War, Pete Hegseth, to substantially reduce the Joint Military Exercises,” with South Korea, President Donald Trump says in a post on Truth Social.

title: BHP Heads Into Earnings With Least Amount of ‘Buy’ Ratings Ever
summary: Analysts are less bullish on BHP Group Ltd. ahead of Tuesday’s full-year results, with buy recommendations for its Sydney-listed stock falling to a record low.

title: US 20-Year Bond Sale to Test Demand as Yield Curve Steepens
summary: The sale of 20-year government bonds this week will test investor appetite for long-term debt following a few record-breaking auctions.

title: Fed’s Internal Rate Debate Faces New Scrutiny
summary: Minutes from the Federal Reserve’s July meeting will offer a closer look at the debate that produced three dissents in favor of a quarter-point rate increase, an unusually visible split as policymakers contend with elevated inflation and mixed economic data. Joining Joe Mathieu and Carol Massar on Bloomberg This Weekend, BMO Capital Markets Senior Economist Jennifer Lee expects the Fed to remain patient, with the firm forecasting no rate move until late 2027, when it expects the central bank to begin cutting. (Source: Bloomberg)
